name: codex-history-live-sync
description: Coordinates idle WSL history imports and a VS Code window reload.

commands.title: Codex History: Complete Setup and Enable
Codex History: Disable and Restore Original Codex
Codex History: Check for New Messages

codexHistoryLiveSync.enabled.description: Enable idle history sync and automatic window reload in a WSL workspace.

codexHistoryLiveSync.controllerTimeoutSe.description: Windows sync timeout; must exceed the controller run budget plus three endpoint timeouts and 60 seconds.

codexHistoryLiveSync.stateDir.description: Absolute Linux directory shared with the optional Codex gateway.

codexHistoryLiveSync.windowsPython.description: Executable Linux mount path to native Windows Python, for example /mnt/c/.../python.exe.

codexHistoryLiveSync.windowsConfig.description: Absolute Windows path to the personal synchronizer config.

codexHistoryLiveSync.previewHelper.description: Absolute Windows path to the read-only eligible-transfer preview helper.
